issues.description: Runtime dependency on setuptools<82 may conflict with user environments
issues.detail: Adding `setuptools<82` to core/setup.py install_requires forces a hard cap on all downstream users of autogluon.core, not just CI. This is a runtime install constraint that propagates into every install, potentially conflicting with newer toolchains. The CI fix should live in CI scripts, not in the package's install_requires.

issues.description: mmdet version bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 without justification
issues.detail: The diff silently bumps mmdet from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 while the stated goal is only to fix the mmengine/setuptools incompatibility. This is an unrelated version change that could introduce behavioral regressions in object detection workflows. The PR description should explain why 3.3.0 is required, or revert to 3.2.0.

issues.description: mmengine pinned to 0.10.7 replaces the torch 2.5 fix from git
issues.detail: The previous install used a specific git commit of mmengine that contained a fix for torch 2.5 compatibility. Switching to PyPI mmengine==0.10.7 may or may not include that fix. Confirm 0.10.7 contains the torch 2.5 fix; otherwise this re-introduces the original bug the git pin was working around.

issues.description: Using --no-build-isolation requires setuptools to already be installed in the env
issues.detail: `mmcv==2.1.0 --no-build-isolation` relies on the active env having setuptools<82 (installed on the line above). This works in CI but is fragile: if line ordering is ever reshuffled or the env is reused, the build will pick up whatever setuptools is present and may fail confusingly. A comment noting the ordering dependency would help.

issues.description: Missing tracking for removal of setuptools<82 cap
issues.detail: Three separate setuptools<82 pins are added (env_setup.sh, setup_mmcv.sh, core/setup.py) all referencing the same upstream mmcv issue. Only two of the three have FIXME comments. The core/setup.py entry has no comment explaining why it exists or when to remove it, making future cleanup error-prone.

review.summary: The PR works around an upstream mmcv/setuptools incompatibility by capping setuptools<82 in CI and switching mmengine to a PyPI wheel. The main concern is that the setuptools<82 constraint leaks into core/setup.py install_requires, propagating a CI-only workaround to all end users. Additionally, mmdet is silently bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 without explanation, and the switch from a pinned git mmengine commit to PyPI 0.10.7 should be verified to preserve the torch 2.5 fix.
